interpretation_limits: The full added-experience chain changes recall proposals and ranking together; this run does not isolate their individual causal contributions.
Same held-out scene recipes and cached observations were reused for correction; this is not a fresh blind test.
The 27 newly plannable cases are a harder selected cohort; do not attribute a lower overall conditional success rate to worse grasp quality without paired comparison.
